Allahabad High Court says UP government misusing Goonda Act

The Allahabad High Court observed that the Uttar Pradesh government is misusing the state's Goonda (Anti‑Social Activities) Act. The court described the law as being used as a tool of oppression and harassment. The observation was reported by both left‑leaning and right‑leaning media outlets. No further details about specific cases or government response were provided in the coverage. The court's remarks highlight concerns about the application of the Act.
